objective: Confirm that the shipped contract examples satisfy both the schema and the semantic checks.

inputs.purpose: Schema the example envelopes are validated against

in: Run the repository's contract validator in both modes
Record the observed outcome of each mode
out: Changing the schema or the examples to make validation pass

acceptance_criteria.description: Schema validation reports every canonical document as valid
acceptance_criteria.verification: Run the validator in schema mode and read its summary line

acceptance_criteria.description: Semantic validation reports no cross-document violation
acceptance_criteria.verification: Run the validator in semantic mode over the example task and result

context_refs.purpose: States which constraints the schema cannot enforce on its own
